;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2014 pro-Russian unrest in Ukraine]]
**Russian foreign minister [[Sergey Lavrov]] rules out any fresh talks in [[Geneva]] to defuse the crisis unless pro-Russian groups are also involved. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-27289897 (BBC News)]

;Arts and culture
*[[Monica Lewinsky]] releases a book recalling her [[Lewinsky scandal|affair]] with then [[United States President]] [[Bill Clinton]]. [https://www.usnews.com/news/blogs/washington-whispers/2014/05/06/monica-lewinsky-returns-a-month-before-hillary-clintons-book-drops (U.S. News & World Report)]
*Thirty young men join the ranks of the [[Swiss Guards]] today, taking an oath of allegiance to [[Pope Francis]] and promising to serve the [[Catholic Church|Church]] by protecting him and his successors. Present at the guards' swearing-in are a number of Vatican dignitaries, the new [[Holy See–Switzerland relations|Swiss ambassador to the Holy See]], Pierre-Yves Fux, and Archbishop [[Giovanni Angelo Becciu]], who is the Substitute for General Affairs of the Secretariat of State. [https://www.catholicnewsagency.com/news/new-swiss-guards-swear-oath-to-protect-pope-francis (Catholic News Agency)]

;Business and economy
*[[Merck & Co]] Inc announces plans to sell its consumer business to [[Bayer AG]] of [[Germany]] for $14 billion. [https://www.reuters.com/article/2014/05/06/us-merck-co-bayer-idUSBREA450BL20140506 (Reuters)]
*[[Office Depot]] says it will close at least 400 of its U.S. stores. [https://www.reuters.com/article/2014/05/06/us-office-depot-results-idUSBREA450DC20140506 (Reuters)] 

;Law and crime
*The [[Prime Minister of Thailand]] [[Yingluck Shinawatra]] appears before the [[Constitutional Court of Thailand|Thai Constitutional Court]] to defend herself against charges of abuse of power. [http://www.dnaindia.com/world/report-thai-pm-yingluck-shinawatra-in-court-for-hearing-that-may-lead-to-her-dismissal-1985446 (Reuters via ''DNA India'')]
*Eight additional Nigerian girls are abducted by suspected [[Boko Haram]] militants following the [[2014 Chibok kidnapping|Chibok kidnappings]].  [http://www.cnn.com/2014/05/06/world/africa/nigeria-abducted-girls/index.html (CNN)]
*[[President of Russia|Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] signs into law a bill that bans profanity at arts, cultural and entertainment events.  [http://www.cnn.com/2014/05/06/world/europe/russia-swearing-law/index.html (CNN)]
*Six people are injured in a [[2014 Guangzhou attack|knife attack]] at a Chinese train station in [[Guangzhou]].  [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-27289398 (BBC News)]

;Politics and elections
*An Egyptian court bans top members of the former ruling [[National Democratic Party (Egypt)|National Democratic Party]] of [[Egyptian Revolution of 2011|ousted]] President [[Hosni Mubarak]] from running in any future elections.
